name: Campingdorf Hofer
beschreibung: Campingdorf Hofer is situated in Zell am Ziller, just a short walk from the town centre and set directly on the banks of the Ziller river. The scenic surroundings in the Zillertal valley provide ideal conditions for outdoor adventures such as hiking, cycling, and skiing. Campsite amenities include comfortable pitches, modern sanitary facilities, and cosy rental chalets. The on-site restaurant Hofer Wirt serves a delicious selection of Tyrolean specialties. The holiday village is renowned for its well-maintained, tranquil ambiance cherished by families and couples alike. Thanks to its close proximity to the Zillertal Arena and Mayrhofen ski resorts, the campsite is also a premier destination throughout the winter season.
